=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
File: scripts/claude_issue_intake.sh
Location: reject() function (around line 110-127)
Issue: When tg_send_msg is invoked inline as part of the reject() body, the failure path is gated with `>/dev/null 2>&1 || true` so the function never aborts on Telegram errors. Good. However, the function also assumes `${RUN_URL}` is set; on a hand-driven run it may be empty, producing a malformed Telegram body (`Run: ` with no URL). The auth gate runs before the existing code that documents RUN_URL as optional, so an empty value would produce a malformed "Run: " prefix in the Telegram message.
Suggested minimal fix: in `reject()`, guard the RUN_URL interpolation with `${RUN_URL:-no-run-url}` so the Telegram message is never malformed.
HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
